purpose: Requested conditional year forecast and feasibility boundary; all unknown actual effects/costs remain UNKNOWN.

assumptions.meaning: Conditional family outcome uses the original target for connected, active and 14-day activation; this is a reverse-calculated target scenario, not an independently estimated take-up forecast.
assumptions.verification: Validate eligible population, linked funnel, incremental connections/exits and mature activity/activation before operational forecast.

assumptions.meaning: Illustrative deployment cohorts: 2000 different families from June, 4000 additional from July, 6000 additional from October. Total 12000 equals conditional year-end family target. All are assumed eligible and still observable; real eligibility and calendar UNKNOWN. Counts are not pilot sample sizes or authorized rollout.
assumptions.verification: Owner-approved eligibility, flow, tariff and delivery schedule; if fewer eligible families, recalculate.

assumptions.meaning: Two eligible numbers per family for arithmetic, not observed average. No extra paid month credited in first month of availability. Subsequent months only through December; number remains tracked after leaving group.
assumptions.verification: Finance-approved paid-month contract and eligible number counts, group-size stratification, no double counting.

assumptions.meaning: New annual direct cost 1000000 RUB is a sensitivity point already used in R0001, not a cost estimate, approved budget or spend. Other incremental contribution O=0 to avoid unproven savings/subscription income.
assumptions.verification: Get quantity-price-period service cost estimate; replace sensitivity point before budget decision.

assumptions.meaning: Required incremental paid-month gap is solved from GP target, not assumed proven; weighted average probability difference must be feasible against counterfactual paid curves, which are UNKNOWN.
assumptions.verification: Controlled paid-month follow-up; check maximum recoverable months from usual-service curve.

assumptions.meaning: Less favourable scenario halves conditional increments in family KPI and paid-month opportunity effect, while direct cost is fixed. This is a stress convention, not probability/quantile/confidence interval; owners remain at no-change forecast.
assumptions.verification: Replace with evidence-based uncertainty after study and cost estimate.

assumptions.meaning: Third-year proposal doubles first-year target for connected/active families at unchanged available base; not approved target or demand forecast. Requires proven benefit, sustainable net contribution and separate yearly financing.
assumptions.verification: Owner decides after year-one demand/cost/retention; revise if eligibility/available base changes.
